item.title: [The Verge] Blue Planet III is keeping the rough edges in the age of AI
item.description: BBC's Blue Planet III is looking to prove its authenticity by leaving in the less-than-perfect shots. Previous incarnations of the nature series were defined by their gorgeous, crystal-clear footage that seemed almost too good to be real. item.title: [The Verge] Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
item.description: On Thursday, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro signed the Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act into law, requiring disclosures on AI-generated ads.
